#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using i64 = long long;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m, MOD;
    cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
    
    if (m > n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    i64 res = 0;
    
    for (int left = 0; left <= m; left++) {
        int right = m - left;
        
        i64 ways = 1;
        ways = (ways * (i64)1 << left) % MOD;
        ways = (ways * (i64)1 << right) % MOD;
        
        i64 comb = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < left; i++) {
            comb = comb * (m - i) % MOD;
            comb = comb * ((i + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < right; i++) {
            comb = comb * (m - left - i) % MOD;
            comb = comb * ((i + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        
        i64 sum_dist = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= left; i++) {
            sum_dist = (sum_dist + (i64)i * (i - 1) / 2) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= right; i++) {
            sum_dist = (sum_dist + (i64)i * (i - 1) / 2) % MOD;
        }
        
        res = (res + ways * comb % MOD * sum_dist) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << res << '\n';
}
